name: incident_id
description: Stable incident key, e.g. INC-4471. Used as the row key in the fixture manifest.

name: service
description: Service the incident was raised against. Joins to services.service.

name: owner_team
description: Owning team. The row access policy predicate reads this column and nothing else.

name: resolved_at
description: Null while the incident is open.

name: title
description: One-line summary shown by search results.

name: postmortem_summary
description: Written after resolution. F1 is planted in this field on a team-b row (schemas.md §3).
